nodes.text: 【神Code伴你行🎶──疏散應變】 Evacuation Tips

假如遇上突發事故服務受阻而需要疏散🚨，個腦絕對唔可以一片空白🧠！就等指揮家畀返個Beat你，教你一啲應變及疏散的小貼士！即刻去片▶️！ #神Code伴你行 #IntheHalloftheMountainKing #出行碼 #最新車務狀況 #突發車務狀況 In the event of evacuation, it’s essential to keep a clear mind🧠! Here are some helpful tips on unexpected situations and evacuation. Watch the video now ▶️! #IntheHalloftheMountainKing #TravelQRCode #RealtimeServiceStatus #EvacuationTips #LatestServiceStatus #TrafficNews
MTR Safety and Service Information Campaign
就可以見到最新車務狀況
留意列車車長指示及這些指引
否則切勿自行打開車門
乘客請在車廂內耐心等候
等候期間留意車廂廣播
列車車長會盡快指示落車的安排
等大家可以安全地離開
每次出行都可以放心啦
按列車車長指示 離開
Scan Travel QR code for real-time service status
MTR provides safety guidelines and digital tools (Travel QR code) for passengers to handle service disruptions and evacuations calmly.
Scan the MTR Travel QR code for real-time service updates and follow staff instructions during emergencies.
Passengers can stay informed and safe during unexpected train service disruptions by using MTR's digital tools and following emergency protocols.
